Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 30 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Vikram - 59 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
3. Sanjay - 36 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Sonali - 26 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Meenakshi - 35 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Vikram and Sanjay stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rajesh is dying to see the new film.]

Vikram: "And then?"

[Rajesh's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Vikram: "How beautiful!"

[Rajesh laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Rajesh: "This is amazing!"

[Rajesh dies in the fire.]

Vikram (excited): "No… this cannot be!"
